name: AWS checkip – outbound IP
doc: Gets the server's outbound (NAT gateway) public IP as plain text. It is called once on the first /diagnostics/ip request and cached; that route returns 403 in production.

name: Praxis invite landing page
doc: Public HTML page for praxis invitation links. It shows a 7-digit invite code (for example 1234567) and redirects to the app deep link. Codes that are not exactly 7 digits get a 404.
